segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct Article: Codable { let title: String let author: String let pubDate: Date } let dataProvider = PassthroughSubject<Article, Never>() let cancellable = dataProvider .encode(encoder: JSONEncoder()) .sink(receiveCompletion: { print ("Completion: \($0)") }, receiveValue: { data in guard let stringRepresentation = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else { return } print("Data received \(data) string representation: \(stringRepresentation)") }) dataProvider.send(Article(title: "My First Article", author: "Gita Kumar", pubDate: Date())) // Prints: "Data received 86 bytes string representation: {"title":"My First Article","author":"Gita Kumar","pubDate":606211803.279603}" ```
